english: Let $y=y(x)$, $0\le x\le5$, be the solution of the differential equation $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{x+3y+19}{3x+y+9}$ with $y(0)=-6$. Then the value of $y(5)$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $y=y(x)$, $0\le x\le5$, अवकल समीकरण $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{x+3y+19}{3x+y+9}$ का वह हल है जिसके लिए $y(0)=-6$ है। तब $y(5)$ का मान ______ है।
solution: At $x=0$: $(X,Y)=(1,0)\Rightarrow K=1$; at $x=5$: $X=6$, $6+Y=(6-Y)^{2}\Rightarrow Y^{2}-13Y+30=0\Rightarrow Y=3$ or $10$
On the branch through $(1,0)$, $X-Y>0$ and $X-Y=s$ increases from $1$: $s=3$ gives $X=6$, $Y=3$ ($Y=10$ has $s=-4$, another branch)
solution_full: Solve $x+3y+19=0$, $3x+y+9=0$: $(x,y)=(-1,-6)$. Put $x=X-1$, $y=Y-6$. Then $x+3y+19=X+3Y$ and $3x+y+9=3X+Y$, so $\dfrac{dY}{dX}=\dfrac{X+3Y}{3X+Y}$, which is homogeneous.
Separate and use partial fractions: $\dfrac{3+v}{(1-v)(1+v)}=\dfrac{2}{1-v}+\dfrac{1}{1+v}$. Integrating, $-2\ln\left|1-v\right|+\ln\left|1+v\right|=\ln\left|X\right|+c$.
So $\dfrac{1+v}{(1-v)^{2}}=KX$. Multiply by $X$ and use $v=\dfrac YX$: $\dfrac{X(X+Y)}{(X-Y)^{2}}=KX$, that is, $X+Y=K(X-Y)^{2}$, a family of parabolas.

Parametrise by $s=X-Y$: $X+Y=s^{2}$, so $X=\dfrac{s^{2}+s}{2}$, $Y=\dfrac{s^{2}-s}{2}$. At the initial point $s=1$. Since $\dfrac{dX}{ds}=\dfrac{2s+1}{2}>0$ for $s>0$ and $3X+Y=2s^{2}+s>0$, the solution is a smooth function $y(x)$ for $s\ge1$.
$x=5$ means $X=6$: $s^{2}+s=12$, $s=3$, so $Y=\dfrac{9-3}{2}=3$. (The other root $s=-4$ lies on a different branch.)
originality_note: New: a reducible-to-homogeneous equation with coefficient pattern (1,3;3,1) whose solution family is the parabolas X + Y = K(X - Y)^2, with a branch decision at the end (way 5). Closest known: dy/dx = (x + 2y - 3)/(2x + y - 3), whose solutions are cubic curves. Different because: the coefficients give parabolas and the quadratic in Y has two roots, only one on the solution branch.

concept_use.Equations reducible to homogeneous form:: The lines x + 3y + 19 = 0 and 3x + y + 9 = 0 meet at (-1,-6); shifting the origin there makes the equation homogeneous, solved by Y = vX and partial fractions, giving the parabolas X + Y = K(X - Y)^2.

key_step: Shift to (-1,-6), Y = vX, partial fractions: X + Y = (X - Y)^2; choose the branch.
justification: Standard reduction with partial fractions and a branch choice; routine but several steps. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q9 (L2).
